obligation: Port Table32 state and nullable references to the single VM, preserving table/reference identity, checked atomic mutations and tracing ownership across instance boundaries.
representation: WasmModule holds canonical TableType declarations. Captured instance bindings own internal WasmTable cells containing ordinary Values, element type and growth limit. RefFunc uses existing Function cells and the existing weak function cache per program/function/environment. Globals, memories, data and tables occupy derived binding domains. No table-specific executor, reference Value encoding, strong function side map or table64 flag is introduced. Grow and bulk operands reuse the existing register-pair layout; validation, liveness and serialization derive from opcodes!.
